newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm on foreign buying.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds firmed in active trading on Monday and dealers said foreign operators were buying paper in the absence of negative news.
"Everything is rising as there is no bad news," Imperial Bank dealer Alexei Denisov said.
Another Russian bank dealer said most of the buyers were from abroad, while no trend was seen inside Russia.
"Prices are in a pit now, so why not buy if one has money," he said.
Buyers were apparently fulfilling client orders, abstaining from opening new positions for themselves, he said.
Dealers said the market had not reacted to news the timetable for President Boris Yeltsin's heart operation, set for mid-November, had not changed.
